feasibility.explanation: Treasure Valley IT is outside ForgeX's target market segment of home-service trade contractors. As an MSP, they already specialize in technical systems administration, IT infrastructure, and software management.

aiDelivery.explanation: No custom ForgeX automation or AI agent is recommended because the company does not fit ForgeX's target profile.

risks.description: Attempting to pitch home-service contractor operational workflows to a technical managed service provider represents a complete operational mismatch.

assumptions: The website does not publish public list prices for managed services, and Treasure Valley IT does not match ForgeX's target business profile.

sourcesUsed.usedFor: Company identity, core services, vendor partners, office location, and primary phone contacts
Company founding background, mission, core values, and community affiliations
Review of leadership and organizational team structure
Verification of corporate identity, data collection practices, and office address confirmation
Operational service scope, client metrics, years in business, and service features

limitations: Specific executive names and titles are not listed on the public 'Meet Our Team' or 'About' pages.
The contact page (https://www.tvit.net/contact-us/) returned an automated HTTP 403 access restriction.
Specific pricing schedules are not published openly on the website.

qualification.rationale: ForgeX targets owner-led home-service contractors (HVAC, plumbing, and electrical) with 10 to 75 staff that pay for leads. Treasure Valley IT is a Managed IT Services Provider (MSP) and cybersecurity firm specializing in commercial network management, helpdesk support, and technical consulting. Because it is outside ForgeX's target vertical and operates as an IT technology firm itself, it is not a fit.
